== Biography ==

Mopsy is one of four little rabbits living with their Mother in a sand-bank beneath the root of a great fir-tree. Along with Flopsy and Cotton-tail, Mopsy is a good little bunny. While Peter ventured into the forbidden garden of Mr. McGregor, Mopsy went down the lane with Flopsy and Cotton-tail to gather blackberries. That evening, the three enjoyed bread and milk along with the blackberries they had gathered.
